edition.publication: In Jacques-Paul Migne, Patrologia Latina 183 (Paris, 1854), columns 453-481
edition.title: In festo omnium Sanctorum sermones I-V, Mabillon's text

alternate_titles: Sermons for the Feast of All Saints
work.author: Bernard of Clairvaux
work.description: Bernard's five sermons for the feast of All Saints, as Mabillon's edition prints them among the Sermones de sanctis. Sermo I is headed De lectione evangelica, Videns Jesus turbas (Matth. v, 1-12) and comments on the beatitudes. Of the others only these places have been read for the record: sermo II nn. 1 and 4 (the saints' intercession; their souls' rest before the resurrection) and sermo V nn. 2, 3 and 5 (the hidden holiness of those still fighting, the fear of God, and why the saints are venerated); sermones III and IV have not been read. A locus is sermon and section.
work.title: Sermones in festo omnium Sanctorum
